title: 1736 Prairie: mansard where the 1911 map draws it; coach house built
items: 1736 Prairie's mansard now stands only where the 1911 fire-insurance map draws its curb: along the street front, and along 18th Street as far as the brick bay. The north side and the rear rise as a straight brick third storey under a coped parapet, which the map's wall figures call for.

The house's coach house on the alley at 18th Street is now built on the coach-house kit at the size the map gives it: two storeys of brick, 15.3 m deep, its gable to 18th Street and a carriage door on the alley.
